title: Padded loop body configuration
statement: For Boolean finite Turing machines $body$ and $F$, a state $anchor$ of $body$, an input word $x$, a configuration $c$ of $body$ on $x$, a Boolean $release$, an optional Boolean $flag$, a Boolean word $word$, and a configuration $fuel$ of $F$ on $x$, the construction that applies the loop-body configuration operation to $c$ and the given control data, then appends the buffer encoding of $word$ and the work tapes of $fuel$, yields a configuration on $x$ with $body.k+1+(1+F.k)$ work tapes and states in $body.State\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The heads on the added tapes are at position zero.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the loop-body configuration operation or buffer encoding, so their resulting state and tape contents cannot be specified further.
